purpose: Define intentionally invalid Contract Format 1.4 fixtures with exact expected failure classes so validators prove that malformed, ambiguous or semantically unsafe artifacts are rejected.

topics.name: Negative Fixture Suite
topics.purpose: Define intentionally invalid Contract Format 1.4 fixtures with exact expected failure classes so validators prove that malformed, ambiguous or semantically unsafe artifacts are rejected.

semantics.failure_rule: Each fixture declares one primary expected hard-fail class plus allowed secondary diagnostics.
semantics.isolation_rule: Fixtures should isolate one failure where practical.
semantics.acceptance_rule: A validator that accepts a mandatory negative fixture is non-conformant.
semantics.diagnostic_rule: Failure output identifies semantic location and violated contract/gate.
semantics.stability_rule: Failure class IDs are stable across compatible validator versions.

invariants.rule: A Contract Format 1.4 conformance claim is backed by reproducible machine-readable fixtures, validation results and exact profile/version identity.

hard_gates.condition: invalid fixture lacks expected failure class
diagnostic cannot identify violated semantic rule
negative fixture relies only on malformed JSON syntax instead of format semantics
failure IDs change incompatibly without versioning

references.purpose: Negative fixtures test validator rejection behavior.
